name: crossplay-companion
description: Private, browser-only screenshot helper for NYT Crossplay

scripts.dev: node scripts/prepare-ocr.mjs && node scripts/prepare-definitions.mjs && node scripts/prepare-languages.mjs && vite
scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-ocr.mjs && node scripts/prepare-definitions.mjs && node scripts/prepare-languages.mjs && vite build
scripts.ios:setup: npm run build && cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
